text:
OpsBot: [INCIDENT] embeddings-service.p99 spike detected • p99=3.2s (5m) • alert: embeds-p99-high • pager: oncall-A • link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alerts/embeds-p99
Mia Park: I'm oncall — picking this up now. any customer-facing tickets yet?
Sandeep Rao: seeing same on infra dashboards. kv-cluster-2 eviction bursts correlate with the timeframe (evict-rate ~2k/s). looks like a cache missstorm.
Devon Lee: traces show repeated model reloads on misses -> high CPU + backpressure into embedding workers. throughput dipped. probable root = eviction cascade + aggressive prefix invalidation.
Mia Park: plan: 1) scale embeddings workers + set temporary lower batch size, 2) disable aggressive prefix cache policy, 3) squelch duplicate pages while we stabilize. doing 1 now.
Cory Tran: can confirm we have spare capacity in the dedicated pool. kicking scale 8 -> 12 for embeddings-service-prod. also prepare toggle for prefix_cache.aggressive = false.
Mia Park: scale job submitted: `kubectl scale deployment/embeddings --replicas=12 -n prod` (run id: scale-1873001234). watching logs.
OpsBot: Event: scale job finished • metric update: embeddings-service.p99 -> 1.12s (2m after scale).
Lena Ortiz: nice. reduce noise: suggest temporary squelch on the alert rule to avoid storming people. propose suppress embeddings-p95 and p90 alerts for 30m tied to this incident ID.
Sandeep Rao: +1 to squelch. long-term we should tune the alert to avoid firing on short eviction blips. current alert fires on p90 > 800ms for 1m — that's noisy. propose new condition: alert only when (p99 > 1.5s for 5m) AND (error_rate > 0.5% in same window) OR sustained eviction_rate > 500/s for 10m.
Devon Lee: agreed. also recommend dashboard tiles for kv-eviction-rate, prefix-cache hit ratio, model-warmup-rate per instance. quick dashboard prototype: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/embeddings-incident-1873001234
Mia Park: I'm creating a post-incident ticket with action items. tentative assignments: Sandeep -> adjust alert rule and vet thresholds; Devon -> autoscale policy and batch-size guardrails; Lena -> update oncall playbook and add explicit cache-toggle step; Cory -> validate dedicated pool autoscaling limits.
Mia Park: Draft alert rule snippet below (will push to alerts repo after review):
```yaml
alert: EmbeddingsHighSeverity
expr: |
  (
    (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(embedding_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))) > 1.5
    and sum(rate(embedding_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(embedding_requests_total[5m])) > 0.005
  )
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "embeddings-service p99 > 1.5s and elevated error rate"
  runbook: "https://playbooks.redwood.internal/embeddings#scale-and-cache-toggle"
```
Mia Park: I'll add the runbook link and a dashboard link in the alert annotation. also will add an `incident_id` tag to squelch rules so oncall retains context.
Sandeep Rao: when you update the alert, please add an annotation field `owner: eng-runtime` and `contact: #eng-runtime` so we don't lose ownership.
Lena Ortiz: for the playbook update, I'll add a step under "Mitigation > Cache missstorm" with the exact commands, and update the handoff checklist to include "squelch active alerts" and "annotate alert with incident_id and owner". will ping docs review.
Devon Lee: quick follow-up: can we add an automated check in the deploy pipeline that flags aggressive prefix_cache toggles? I can draft a preflight.
Mia Park: great. action items logged: https://tickets.redwood.internal/INC-1873001234 (assignments + ETA). I'll schedule a 30m debrief + runbook edit session at 10:30am PT.
Cory Tran: confirmed, I'll annotate the dedicated pool change and post the autoscale limits in the ticket.
Mia Park: closing loop — p99 stabilized at ~1.05s now, keeping monitoring for 30m. thanks all. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Incident note saved • incident_id=INC-1873001234 • timeline updated.
Lena Ortiz: postmortem: once we validate alert thresholds and dashboard coverage, let's roll the new rule in staging for 48h to avoid regression. tagging @oncall-next for awareness.
Mia Park: filing the runbook PR now (PR: https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/PR-452). will update thread when merged.
Devon Lee: PR looked good, left one comment on the `for: 5m` duration — suggests 7m for high-noise regions.
Mia Park: noted, updating PR. final note: owners listed in ticket and runbook section. thanks everyone for quick coordination."
